title: Flappy Brobbey: He Went Down Easy
story: You are Brian Brobbey and the slightest touch sends you to the floor. Sunderland just beat Chelsea 1-0 off your penalty, Chelsea fans swear you tripped yourself, and now every VAR monitor in the Stadium of Light wants a second look. Spam-tap to stay upright.
inspiration: Sunderland 1-0 Chelsea at the Stadium of Light, 8 Nov 2026: Le Fee's 36th-minute penalty after Brian Brobbey went down under Levi Colwill; Chelsea fans insist Brobbey tripped himself and VAR denied Palmer a penalty (X Trending 2119438237290926585, 8 Nov 2026; Brobbey/Colwill/Sunderland trending worldwide). Archetype: Twitchy — gravity 1.08 so he hits the deck the instant you stop tapping (apex ~25px). Brobbey portrait (Wikimedia Commons, GAE - Ajax - 52788522258) cut with rembg, tilted mid-fall; VAR monitor (Commons 'VAR by BISO0074') masked onto a pitchside pole; Stadium of Light exterior (geograph 5813935, Commons).
